summary: Cycle 4: exhaustive analysis of NF transfer chain confirms depth gap is unavoidable with current ExistPart architecture. nf_extend_fwd loses one depth level per application; this creates a systematic one-level shortfall when transferring depth-(k'+1+1) 2-var evaluations. The constant-parent limitation of ExistPart (env = fun _ => t) prevents encoding non-constant parent 3-var existentials [y, x, t] for x != t. Three resolution paths identified; Path A (strengthen ExistPart with parent NF types) is recommended.
blockers: ARCHITECTURAL: ExistPart's constant-parent env (fun _ => t) cannot express 3-var existentials ∃ y, nf_eval_nf M (k'+1) 3 [y, x, t] ssn for x != t. The NF transfer (nf_extend_fwd) from depth-(k'+2) 1-var agreement gives depth-(k'+1) 2-var agreement, but sub_nf.2 records depth-(k'+1) 3-var satisfiability. From depth-(k'+1) 2-var agreement, nf_extend gives depth-k' 3-var agreement — one level short. This depth gap propagates at every subsequent level.
Until backward (KampBypass.lean:356): Formula is provably too weak. compat_disj.untl top only encodes x's 1-var NF type, not the 2-var quantifier conditions at [x, t].

continuation_context.recommended_approach: Path A: Redefine ExistPart to carry parent NF types (not just parent_atoms). ExistPart_r(k) parameterized by r parent NFs at depth k+1. The mutual induction step at depth k+1 uses ExistPart_r(k) with r=2 parents [nf_x, nf_t] to express 3-var existentials with non-constant env. Estimated scope: ~500 lines.
alternative_approaches: Path B: Feferman-Vaught composition theorem — prove interval-type determines multi-var NF using NEquivalence.lean infrastructure (~1000+ lines)
Path C: Direct depth-recursive formula construction mirroring k=0 VecEA2 brackets with char_kp1 (~800 lines)
continuation_context.depth_gap_explanation: nf_extend_fwd : depth-(K+1) r-var agreement → depth-K (r+1)-var agreement. To transfer sub_nf at depth k'+2 arity 2, need depth-(k'+3) arity-1 agreement — have depth-(k'+2). To transfer quantifier conditions at depth k'+1 arity 3, need depth-(k'+2) arity-2 agreement — have depth-(k'+1). Each step is one short. The gap propagates through k'+1 levels of recursion.
continuation_context.key_invariant: At recursion level j (j=0,...,k'+1): have depth-(k'+1-j) (j+2)-var agreement, need depth-(k'+2-j) (j+2)-var evaluation. Agreement is always one level below evaluation depth.
continuation_context.why_eq_zone_works: When x = t: env [y, x, t] = [y, t, t] = Fin.cons y (fun _ => t). This IS a constant-parent env, so ih_exist applies directly.
continuation_context.files_unchanged: No code changes in this cycle — analysis only.
